name: Pages CMS
title: Mica vs. Pages CMS
summary: Pages CMS is a free editor for GitHub repositories, with a hosted app that needs no install and email invites for people without GitHub. Mica works with any Git host, needs no database, and has an MCP server for AI agents.

chooseMica.text: You want AI agents to edit your content: Mica has an MCP server built in. The Pages CMS documentation mentions no MCP or agent support.
Your repository is not on GitHub.
You want to run the editor yourself with no database, behind your OpenID Connect provider.
You need a map field, or reference data from a file.

chooseOther.text: You want a free hosted app and no install at all.
Some editors have no GitHub account. Pages CMS invites them by email, with a one-time code.
Your editors work with CSV data in a grid, or you want buttons that start GitHub Actions.

facts.value: Yes. Use the free hosted app (app.pagescms.org), or self-host it: Node, PostgreSQL, a GitHub App, a public HTTPS URL, and email through Resend or SMTP.
PostgreSQL for sessions, collaborators and a cache. It holds no content.
MIT. Free everywhere. No paid plans.
Listed as supported. It works on plain files. There is no Astro package.
GitHub, or an email one-time code for invited collaborators. No SSO or OIDC.
Each save is one commit to the branch, through the GitHub Contents API. No pull request or publish workflow. Action buttons start GitHub Actions.
No. Issue #407 is open. A fix in pull request #451 is open since 17 October 2026.
Not supported for external data. A reference field points to a configured collection.
None in the release. A branch that is not merged has it.
GitHub users and email collaborators. Granular permissions are listed as Soon. No review.
Not documented. The documentation mentions no MCP server and no agent support.
